summary: End-to-end UI validation of Admin Dashboard auto-save HSIA correction feature. All acceptance criteria pass: (1) inline HSIA on 'Absensi Hari Ini' expanded row saves without a Simpan button and shows 'Status siswa diperbarui' toast; (2) 'Belum Absen' card lists absent students, izin button marks them and moves them into the top table with correct status; (3) deletion cleanup works; (4) stat-card filter chip, search, pagination, and date picker all functional; (5) mobile 390px shows no horizontal overflow on dashboard content. Test data cleaned up after run.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.jsx line ~64: useEffect deps only include [attDate] with eslint-disable; showAbsent/loadAbsent are captured via closure. Works today but fragile — consider including showAbsent in deps or refactoring.

Login inputs (data-testid login-email/login-password) lack proper type='email' / type='password' attributes on the <input>. Autofill/keyboard hints suffer. Testing agent used data-testid to work around. Minor.

Task instructions referenced yesterday=2026-09-23 for the absent-card test, but demo seed had records for both today (2026-09-24) and yesterday for all 8 students, so absent list was empty on those dates. Tester used 2026-09-20 (7 absent) to validate the flow. If seed is intended to leave some absent yesterday, seed script should be adjusted.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created an 'izin' record for one student on 2026-09-20 and deleted it. Temporarily changed Afghan Fahrozi's 2026-09-24 status to 'sakit' and restored to 'present' via API. No residual test data remains.
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminDashboard auto-save HSIA (inline + absent card) verified working with real backend. Note: seed data has all 8 students marked present for both today and yesterday, so to test the 'Belum Absen' flow you must pick an older date (e.g., 2026-09-20 had 7 absent). The att-date input has a max=today attribute; you can remove it via JS before setting past dates. Restore-to-present flow in Playwright must re-expand the row after collapse/date change because HSIA buttons only render in an expanded panel — otherwise the click selector times out.
